metadata.title: आदिवासी, दलित, ओबीसी और अल्पसंख्यक की आवाज़ बनूंगा - राजकुमार रोत | Interview Rajkumar Roat
metadata.description:
Rajkumar Roat, a tribal MP from Banswara in Rajasthan, has recently been in the spotlight due to a heated debate on tribal identity with a minister from his home state. In an interview, Roat asserted that the Adivasis of India are not Hindus and possess a distinct religious identity. This statement prompted minister Madan Dilawar to challenge Roat to check his DNA to determine if he is Hindu.

Roat is currently in New Delhi to attend the first session of parliament as an MP. In an interview with Main Bhi Bharat editor Shyam Sunder, he outlined his priorities, promising to advocate for the rights of Adivasi, OBC, and minority communities in the house. Roat emphasized his commitment to addressing the issues and concerns of these marginalized groups, ensuring their voices are heard and their rights protected.
